About Wrapstick

Food's Timeline

Wrapstick Foods is a leading name in India for its Delicious & Unique Arabic, Turkish, Lebanese Indo-western edibles, among these are Fried chicken, Grilled Chicken, Shawarma, Kebabs, Veg and Chicken Burgers, Wraps and Thick Shakes. Founded in 2011 the company has 40+ Food Stores in Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana, Gujarat and Maharashtra. Every product available at Wrapstick food stores are created with art and crafted by own recipes & Spice blends.

Each and every product has its own signature flavor and mouthwatering taste, which are sold at an unbeatable and affordable price. Wrapstick has its own handpicked and prepared marinades and spice blends that are used for preparation of amazing delightful edibles.
Wrapstick foods pvt ltd & Khatri TradCo together manage all the franchise expansion and Raw material logistics PAN India.

Company runs on both Franchise model and Company owned food store models. Major franchises are currently operating in Cities like Udaipur, Gandhidham, Banswara, Dahod, Vadodara, Bhuj, Himmat Nagar, Dungarpur, Ratlam, Indore, Jhunjhunu, Bikaner, Pilani and more in 40+ Locations. Company owned model Food stores are running in Pune, Indore, Udaipur and Jhunjhunu.
